skill_name: Explain why a student should not run a GPT language model at scale on a laptop computer.
workflow: Running a GPT language model at scale on a laptop computer is not recommended due to the computational power it requires. GPT models use large neural networks that consume large amounts of memory and computing power. Running them on a laptop computer, which typically has limited computing power and memory, will likely cause significantly slower training and inference times.
